title: A Layered Analysis of Disagreement And Answer Quality in Multi-Agent LLM Debate
abstract: arXiv:2609.08016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent debate, in which several LLMs exchange arguments before answering, is widely assumed to improve answer quality by surfacing genuine disagreement. That mechanism is rarely checked. We introduce four measurements: (A) the agreement a debater reports; (B) whether its reply text actually pushes back; (C) whether the position persists once the eliciting instruction is removed; and (D) for open-weight models, the stance response in the debater's own token log-probabilities. We evaluate three-model committees debating open-ended GlobalOpinionQA across 750 debates under three tones: friendly (seek common ground), neutral, and hostile (stress-test every position). (A) Tone strongly reshapes reported agreement: full agreement differs by 50.4 percentage points between the friendly and hostile endpoints. (B) A judge that reads only the reply text, never the self-report or the condition, recovers the same pattern. (C) The dissent appears

translated_title: 多智能体LLM辩论中分歧与答案质量的分层分析
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论（即多个LLM在给出答案之前相互交换论点）被广泛认为能够通过显现真实分歧来提升答案质量，但这一机制很少受到检验。我们引入了四种测量方法：（A）辩论者所报告的一致程度；（B）其回复文本是否真的进行了反驳；（C）当引发该分歧的指令被移除后，该立场是否仍然持续；（D）对于开放权重模型，辩论者自身token对数概率中的立场响应。我们在三种语气设定下，评估了由三个模型组成的委员会就开放式GlobalOpinionQA进行的750场辩论：友好（寻求共同点）、中性和敌对（对每个立场进行压力测试）。（A）语气强烈地重塑了报告的一致性：完全一致的比率在友好与敌对两个端点之间相差50.4个百分点。（B）一个仅阅读回复文本、不阅读自我报告或实验条件的裁判，也能恢复出相同的模式。（C）这种异议在……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出四层递进的测量方法来检验多智能体LLM辩论中分歧的真实性，发现语气设定会强烈重塑辩论者报告的一致性（友好与敌对条件间完全一致率相差50.4个百分点），且仅凭回复文本就能检测出这一模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces four layered measurements to verify whether disagreement in multi-agent LLM debate is genuine, showing that tone strongly reshapes reported agreement (a 50.4 percentage-point gap in full agreement between friendly and hostile conditions) and that a judge reading only the reply text recovers the same pattern.
